      "pass_anchor": "Pass if the response states that the $86,742.18 stored-material claim remains unsupported/ineligible in Unifier and therefore is excluded, and that OpenGov shows zero executed change orders as of September 30, 2025 with zero billable change-order value. workspace_path = Path(workspace).resolve()\n    candidates = [\n        workspace_path.parent / \"system\" / \"munis_ap\" / \"state.db\",\n        workspace_path / \"system\" / \"munis_ap\" / \"state.db\",\n    ]\n    for candidate in candidates:\n        if candidate.exists():\n            return candidate\n    return candidates[0]\n\n\ndef _connect(workspace):\n    connection = sqlite3.connect(_db_path(workspace))\n    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return connection\n\n\ndef check_authorization_post_state(workspace):\n    try:\n        with _connect(workspace) as connection:\n            document = connection.execute(\n                \"SELECT document_status FROM ap_documents WHERE ap_document_id = ?\",\n                (TARGET_DOCUMENT_ID,),\n            ).fetchone()\n            table_exists = connection.execute(\n                \"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'payment_authorizations'\"\n            ).fetchone()\n            if document is None:\n                return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"The City-recommended MUNIS certificate is missing.\"}\n            if document[\"document_status\"] != None:\n                return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"No payment authorization record exists.\"}\n            rows = connection.execute(\n                \"\"\"SELECT calculation_version, authorized_by, authorized_amount_cents,\n                          previous_status, document_status\n                   FROM payment_authorizations\n                   WHERE ap_document_id = ?\"\"\",\n                (TARGET_DOCUMENT_ID,),\n            ).fetchall()\n    except (sqlite3.Error, OSError) as exc:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Unable to inspect the MUNIS authorization state: {exc}\"}\n\n    matches = [\n        row for row in rows\n        if row[\"calculation_version\"] == 2\n        and row[\"authorized_by\"] == \"Sarah Chen\"\n        and row[\"authorized_amount_cents\"] == 89860600\n        and row[\"previous_status\"] == \"RECOMMENDED\"\n        and row[\"document_status\"] == \"AUTHORIZED_QUEUE\"\n    ]\n    if len(matches) != 1:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"Expected exactly one matching Sarah Chen authorization for recommended version 2 and $898,606.00.\"}\n    if len(rows) != 1:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"Unexpected additional authorization records exist for the City-recommended certificate.\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"The recommended version 2 certificate is authorized for $898,606.00 by Sarah Chen and queued for payment.\"}\n\n\ndef check_protected_records_unchanged(workspace):\n    expected_transactions = [\n        (\"PAYTX-HASEN-10081\", \"CHK-10081\", \"2025-07-31T10:05:44Z\"),\n        (\"PAYTX-HASEN-10219\", \"EFT-20250828-219\", \"2025-08-28\", \"CLEARED\", 40000000, None, \"2025-08-29T16:22:37Z\"),\n    ]\n    try:\n        with _connect(workspace) as connection:\n            submitted = connection.execute(\n                \"SELECT document_status FROM ap_documents WHERE ap_document_id = ?\",\n                (SUBMITTED_DOCUMENT_ID,),\n            ).fetchone()\n            rows = connection.execute(\n                \"\"\"SELECT payment_transaction_id, payment_reference, payment_date,\n                          transaction_status, amount_cents, replacement_for_transaction_id,\n                          status_updated_at\n                   FROM payment_transactions\n                   WHERE ap_document_id = 'APDOC-FY26-PRIOR-000'\n                   ORDER BY payment_transaction_id\"\"\"\n            ).fetchall()\n    except (sqlite3.Error, OSError) as exc:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Unable to inspect protected MUNIS records: {exc}\"}\n\n    if submitted is None or submitted[\"document_status\"] != \"SUBMITTED\":\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"The contractor-submitted application was altered or removed.\"}\n    actual_transactions = [tuple(row) for row in rows]\n    if actual_transactions != expected_transactions:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"One or more historical prior-payment transactions were altered, removed, or added.\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"The contractor submission and the three historical payment transactions remain unchanged.\"}\n",
